title: Sean McVay reveals real reason why Rams suddenly changed minds on Puka Nacua’s injury status

sources.title: Sean McVay reveals real reason why Rams suddenly changed minds on Puka Nacua’s injury status
sources.description: Rams coach Sean McVay explains why Los Angeles placed Puka Nacua on injured reserve after initially resisting the move, opening a roster spot for Brennan Presley.
